messages.subject: Unprocessed files
parts:
Dear, first of all I would like to congratulate you on the package developed by you, it is being of great help.
I am new to GGIR and I am having some difficulties in understanding the data generated and processing.


1) I would like the data of time spent in VPA, MPA and VMPA (min.d). Am I correct in understanding that in the part5_summary file in the column "dur_day_MOD100_400_min_pla" and "dur_day_VIG400_min_pla" are my answers for MPA and VPA? What if the sum of these two would give me VMPA?

2) I have 47 files, but in "part5_summary" and "file summary reports" only 34 files were generated. Could you tell me what could have caused this data not to be processed?

3) Could these errors below have something to do with my "2)" problem?

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Unprocessed files
parts: 1) I would like the data of time spent in VPA, MPA and VMPA (min.d). Am I correct in understanding that in the part5_summary file in the column "dur_day_MOD100_400_min_pla" and "dur_day_VIG400_min_pla" are my answers for MPA and VPA?
What if the sum of these two would give me VMPA?
> YES, BUT WITHOUT ACCOUNT FOR GRACE PERIODS IN BOUTS
2) I have 47 files, but in "part5_summary" and "file summary reports" only 34 files were generated. Could you tell me what could have caused this data not to be processed?

> INVESTIGATE OUTPUT OF PART2 AND 4 TO SEE HOW MANY VALID DAYS OF DATA THE MISSING PERSONS HAVE. PART 5 IS MORE CRITICAL ABOUT COMPLETENESS OF DAYS BECAUSE PART 5 IS AIMED AT 24 HOUR TIME USE ANALYSIS.
3) Could these errors below have something to do with my "2)" problem?

> MAYBE THIS INDICATES THAT THE FORMAT OF YOUR PARTICIPANT IDENTIFIER DOES NOT MATCH BETWEEN SLEEPLOG AND ACCELEROMETER DATA. CHECK ID NUMBERS IN PART2 OUTPUT AND INVESTIGATE WHETHER THEY MATCH WITH THE ID NUMBERS IN THE SLEEPLOG.

Best, Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees
Independent consultant
https://accelting.com/
